visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man in a white t-shirt and black athletic shorts performs an energetic solo dance in a cluttered indoor room. He spins glowing orange light sticks rapidly, creating circular light trails. The background is a classroom-like setting with tatami mats on the floor, shelves filled with bags and equipment, and posters on the wall. Two other male students stand in the background watching him. The room is well-lit with overhead lighting. (2) The scene cuts to a dim hallway where a group of about seven young men are performing a synchronized dance routine with light sticks of various colors (orange, blue, pink). They are positioned in a wide formation, wearing casual t-shirts, shorts, and face masks. The camera remains mostly static as they move their arms in large arcs, filling the frame with vibrant light trails against the darker background of the hallway. (3) Several quick cuts show the group from slightly different angles as they continue their coordinated movements. The dancers perform deep lunges and arm sweeps in unison. The environment remains consistent, a long hallway with fluorescent ceiling lights and white walls. The visual focus is on the contrast between the dark environment and the colorful, flowing light patterns generated by the performers' sticks.
